Gaps and implications

Your customer journey today: a free e-book, an A$44 challenge, then 1:1 coaching at a price nobody can see

1

Your A$44 challenge and events run on set dates, so between them there is no always-on way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren't ready for coaching or a retreat yet.

2

And your 1:1 price isn't public, so every application and free call has to qualify women by hand.

*95% is an industry estimate, not your data.

Retreats sell in waves

Every retreat starts from zero

Each Femme Flow retreat has to be filled from your own posts, stories and conversations. Your waitlist only grows when someone finds it in your Linktree.

Small steps on set dates

The A$44 yes comes and goes

Your challenge and live events give women a small first step, but only while one is running. In between, a woman who isn't ready for coaching has nothing to buy.

Content treadmill

1,113 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next event. When you step back to rest or run a retreat, the lead flow steps back too.

The women who feel made for more but aren't ready for coaching or a retreat can only say a small yes while a challenge or event is open, so in between most of them say nothing.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass for women who know they're made for more, with a home retreat kit straight after

You already have the audience, the voice and the retreats. What's missing is one evergreen 60-minute class that walks women through the mindset shifts you teach, offers a low-ticket home retreat kit on the thank-you page, and invites the right women to apply on the replay. Meta ads put that class in front of new women every day, and the $17 seats plus the kit help pay for the ads.

Audience + Meta ads9,151 on Instagram, your event rooms, plus new reach from ads

The 95%*

They buy a seat for $17, take the home retreat kit, and keep learning from your emails and posts. They pay you a small amount while they build trust, and many come back for coaching or a retreat later.

Before you grab your seat

Who is this for?

Women who know they're made for more and are ready to stop just thinking about it, and start doing the daily mindset work that helps them act on it.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, available for 7 days, so you can watch when it suits you.

What does it cost?

$17. That covers the 60-minute masterclass, the Made For More reflection sheet (PDF), the live Q&A with Shannen and the 7-day replay.

What should I bring?

A notebook, a cup of tea and 60 minutes to yourself. Shannen walks you through a simple morning practice live.

What happens after I sign up?

Check your inbox for your confirmation from Shannen. At the end of the class, Shannen explains how 1:1 coaching and the FemFlow Retreat work, so you can choose the support that fits.

Is this therapy?

No. It's mindset coaching and education, not therapy or medical advice. Everyone's experience is different.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The Monday restart"

Hook
"If you've restarted your 'new life' every Monday this year, this one's for you." (to camera, warm natural light, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"Most women I work with already know they're made for more. Knowing isn't the problem. It's the stories running quietly in the background, and having no simple daily practice to keep you moving once real life kicks in." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach the exact practice in a 60-minute masterclass called Made For More. It's $17. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not therapy."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions for your morning"

Hook
"Three questions I ask every single morning, and you can steal them." (Shannen holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: how do I want to feel today? Two: which story is trying to run the show? Three: what's one small brave thing I can do before tonight?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"I walk through the full morning reset in my Made For More masterclass. Link below."
